description: Search live Shiplist listings by keyword across name, tagline, description and tags. Omit query to browse the newest. Narrow by pricing, open source and platform; a listing whose value is unknown never matches that filter. Each listing carries attributes: pricing, openSource, repoUrl and platforms, null when unknown.

platform.description: Only listings that run on this platform; api_cli covers APIs, SDKs and CLIs

pricing.description: Only listings with this pricing model; free_trial means paid after a trial

title: Search listings
